decisions.reason: As an incremental extension of the core heat-exchanger portfolio that remained marketed longer than the other 2018 launches, finned tubes likely met minimum aspiration levels and fit a growing, R&D-active firm with enough slack to retain complementary offerings.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes build directly on existing engineering and service capabilities, and their continued presence after launch suggests performance at least around aspiration, so management would keep them rather than redeploy resources prematurely.
